headline: Barry Callebaut expands in India; spirulina tested as cocoa powder substitute
summary: Barry Callebaut is significantly expanding its Indian ingredients manufacturing, raising competitive pressure on Belcolade and Puratos fillings in India.
A new study replaces cocoa powder with spirulina in dark chocolate, a possible partial cocoa alternative worth screening as cocoa costs stay high.
Indonesian cocoa genotype research links volatiles to flavour after postharvest processing, useful for origin selection and fermentation protocols.
A class action over an allulose-based '1g Total Sugars' claim is a reminder to review low-sugar claim wording on reformulated fillings and chocolate.
Market forecasts point to continued clean-label and precision-fermentation demand for fermented ingredients, supporting the sourdough portfolio.

items.title: Major expansion for Barry Callebaut’s Indian ingredients manufacturing
items.summary: Barry Callebaut announces a major expansion of its Indian ingredients manufacturing.
items.why: Competitor capacity build in India intensifies competition for Belcolade and Puratos fillings in a fast-growing chocolate market.

items.title: Spirulina biomass as a cocoa powder substitute in dark chocolate bars: Impact on their physicochemical, nutritional, and sensory properties
items.summary: Study replacing cocoa powder with spirulina biomass in dark chocolate bars, measuring physicochemical, nutritional and sensory effects.
items.why: A partial cocoa-powder substitute with protein and colour benefits is relevant to Belcolade's cocoa-alternative and cost-hedging work amid high cocoa prices.

items.title: Identification of volatile compounds associated with sensory attributes in Indonesian cocoa bean genotypes after postharvest processing using metabolomic and multivariate analysis
items.summary: Metabolomic study linking volatile compounds to sensory attributes across Indonesian cocoa genotypes after postharvest processing.
items.why: Genotype and postharvest flavour markers could support Belcolade origin selection and fermentation protocols for Asian cocoa.

items.title: Fermented Ingredients Market Forecast to 2035, Driven by Clean-Label Reformulation and Precision Fermentation
items.summary: Market report forecasting fermented ingredients to 2035, driven by clean-label reformulation and precision fermentation.
items.why: Confirms demand tailwind for Puratos's sourdough and fermentation-based clean-label ingredients; useful for sizing, not a partner lead.

items.title: An Integrated Text Mining and Content Analysis to Inform Climate‐Smart Cocoa Practices
items.summary: Review plus Delphi study of climate-smart cocoa practices and barriers to adoption in cocoa-producing countries.
items.why: Useful input for Puratos's Cacao-Trace and cocoa sustainability programs on which farm practices experts prioritise.
